We are continuing to grow and are looking for an QA Automation Engineer.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Automate test procedures and cases using approved software tools, following our internal QA Automation standards.
  • Participate in Code-Review process.
  • Design and execute SQL statements for database manipulation and querying.
  • Communicate results of software testing efforts to management through the creation of test summaries and logs.
  • Learn and understand the technical details of all relevant products and gain hands-on familiarity of the system as required.
  • Work with management to define and establish processes, templates, and standards related to software testing and to continually improve the quality of the process.
  • Raise concerns regarding quality to management and team members.
  • Monitor status of software bugs found and ensure they are resolved by software engineers.
  • Any other tasks required by management.
  • Perform various types of testing including black box, white box, integration, functional, systems, sanity, smoke, regression, acceptance, stress, load, performance, usability, installation, recovery, security, compatibility, and more on software systems.
  • Analyze the test basis for test conditions.
  • Conduct verbal discussions with stakeholders, analyze programming source code, and utilize any other methods necessary to find additional test conditions.
  • Prioritize test conditions to ensure that those having the highest impact on the system are tested first.
  • Create and modify written test procedures, test cases, test logs, and other test-related documentation using approved software tools.
  • Manually execute test procedures and cases.


Skills Required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio (.NET/C#) or Java. JavaScript and HTML as well as SQL Server experience are preferred as well.
  • Experience with docker and microservice applications.
  • Solid Object-Oriented Programming paradigm understanding and experience.
  • Experience with web applications and multiple web browsers (such as IE, Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.)
  • BS degree in Computer Science or Engineering or Software Testing required.
  • Excellent research, analytical, and organization skills with an exceptional eye for detail
  • Experience with and/or passion for both code and product excellence. You care about the quality of software your company’s software.
  • Excellent English writing skills is essential to creating useful and consistent test documentation that can be utilized by
  • Proficient English verbal communication skills
  • Experience working with at least one bug-tracking tool such as Team Foundation Server, JIRA, etc.
  • Ability to quickly and independently learn about new technologies, business and technical terms and concepts is essential.
  • Ability to perform software testing activities on a wide variety of complex software applications and systems, platforms and devices that utilize various technologies.
  • Reviewing programming code in various programming languages is essential to performing white box testing.
  • Ability to collaborate with multiple departments and teams, demonstrating high-quality interpersonal skills, including good listening skills, respectful treatment of others, and professional behavior.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and individually with a self-starter ("can do") attitude.
  • Ability to perform testing activities according to set priorities and delivery time lines
  • Ability to take constructive criticism.
  • Ability to perform testing activities for multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with Agile as it relates to software testing is an asset.


Preferred Skills/Experience:

title: Data Engineer (Azure/Databricks)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data solutions using Azure Databricks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of data pipelines, drive best practices in data architecture, and ensure high-quality, reliable data is delivered to support analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, ensuring alignment with lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Design and implement end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources, transform it based on business requirements, and deliver it to downstream consumers
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Apache Spark and PySpark jobs to efficiently process large-scale datasets
  • Implement data quality frameworks, validation processes, and monitoring/alerting systems to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and availability
  • Drive best practices by developing reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized approaches for data engineering across the team
  • Optimize query performance and resource utilization within Azure environments to ensure cost efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, workflows, and architecture while ensuring compliance with security and governance policies
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and promote engineering excellence within the data organization


Need to Haves


  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 2+ years working with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark, along with advanced SQL (especially Spark SQL)
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven ETL pipelines and orchestrating workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns
  • Experience with Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, REST APIs, SFTP, and Azure Key Vault
  • Proficiency in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with CI/CD practices for deploying and managing data pipelines
  • Fluent English to interact with international teams


Nice to Haves


  • Experience working with large-scale distributed data systems and performance optimization techniques
  • Familiarity with data quality, testing, and observability frameworks
  • Experience supporting analytics or data science teams with curated and accessible datasets
  • Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud data environments
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices in cloud platforms

Principais responsabilidades

Esta é uma função predominantemente operacional , com forte expectativa de execução direta.

No dia a dia, essa pessoa será responsável por:

  • Organizar e padronizar a base de dados no CRM

  • Apoiar o time no uso correto do CRM e nas boas práticas operacionais


É uma função de responsabilidade individual alta , com impacto direto no faturamento.


O que se espera nos primeiros 90 dias

  • Base de dados organizada, segmentada e com padrões claros
  • Processos simples de ativação comercial definidos e rodando
  • Primeiras automações funcionando de forma consistente
  • Aumento perceptível de conversão e reaproveitamento da base
  • Redução de ações comerciais reativas e aumento de previsibilidade


Indicadores de sucesso

A performance será acompanhada principalmente por:

  • Evolução da organização e qualidade da base de dados
  • Eficiência das automações implementadas
  • Uso do CRM pelas áreas envolvidas
  • Impacto das ações de CRM nas vendas
  • Análises semanais junto à liderança


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com CRM comercial e automação

  • Experiência com campanhas de CRM voltadas a vendas
  • Conhecimento em e-mail marketing e automações
  • Capacidade de operar indicadores e dados no dia a dia
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema Zoho será um diferencial relevante


Remuneração e benefícios

  • Salário fixo: R$ 4.500,00 (CLT)
  • Variável: até R$ 2.000,00, atrelado a metas objetivas de CRM (após período de adaptação)

Descrição da vaga

Atuar como especialista em performance de banco de dados e facilitador junto aos times de desenvolvimento. Sua missão será garantir a eficiência técnica das aplicações através da modelagem de dados otimizada, refatoração de código (PL/SQL) e análise profunda de execução, focando primordialmente em ambientes Oracle e apoiando ecossistemas SQL Server e PostgreSQL .


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Análise e Otimização: Realizar o tuning e a refatoração de consultas SQL, views e packages (PL/SQL), garantindo o melhor plano de execução e consumo de recursos;
  • Apoio ao Desenvolvimento: Atuar consultivamente com os desenvolvedores na construção de soluções, revisão de código e definição de modelos de dados de alta performance;
  • Análisede Trace: Realizar análises detalhadas de trace e planos de execução (Execution Plan) para identificar gargalos e propor melhorias estruturais ou de lógica;
  • Modelagem de Dados: Elaborar e revisar modelos de dados conceituais, lógicos e físicos, aplicando as melhores práticas para garantir a escalabilidade e a integridade das informações;
  • Estratégias de Performance: Definir e implementar estratégias de particionamento, indexação avançada e estatísticas para suportar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Identificar proativamente queries lentas ou processos ineficientes em ambiente de produção e propor soluções de correção;
  • Testes de Carga: Participar da definição e execução de testes de carga, analisando o comportamento do banco de dados sob estresse e sugerindo ajustes de arquitetura de aplicação;
  • Arquitetura de Dados: Projetar e manter estruturas de dados eficientes para ambientes relacionais e multidimensionais, alinhando o design técnico aos requisitos de negócio;
  • Documentação Técnica: Documentar padrões de desenvolvimento em banco de dados e modelos de dados para disseminação de conhecimento entre as equipes de tecnologia.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida como DBA com foco em Aplicação , focado em otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados;
  • Domínioavançado em Oracle (incluindo tuning de PL/SQL, análise de trace, AWR e execução de planos);
  • Conhecimento profundo em técnicas de tunning, particionamento e indexação;
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados (Relacional e Dimensional);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de performance de banco de dados.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações em banco de dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos em Microsoft SQL Server e PostgreSQL ;
  • Experiência combancos de dados em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
  • Conhecimento emmetodologias ágeis e práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a banco de dados (Database DevOps);
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados NoSQL.

title: User Insights & Engagement Trainee
description:

title: Arquiteto De Soluções Especializado Em Dados, Ia Para A Microsoft
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Arquiteto de Soluções especializado em Dados, IA para a Microsoft

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar na área de Soluções Empresariais que queiram aprender e transformar sua carreira na TCS.

Descrição do cargo:

Como Arquiteto de Soluções especializado em Dados e IA da Microsoft, você será o líder estratégico responsável por projetar a arquitetura digital de próxima geração para transformar nossas operações globais da Indústria de Mineração. Seu foco principal será avaliar a arquitetura de estados atual e definir a arquitetura de estado-alvo, estabelecer padrões técnicos de governança e desenvolver o roteiro tecnológico de vários anos nos domínios de Análise, Automação e IA. Esse papel fundamental exige profunda expertise técnica e a capacidade de superar desafios complexos de integração de TI e Tecnologia Operacional (OT), garantindo que todas as soluções sejam altamente escaláveis, resilientes e seguras para apoiar operações de mineração 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, e aproveitar volumes massivos de dados empresariais e de sensores.

Responsabilidades:

Análise e Arquitetura de Dados

  • Definição do Estado Alvo: Defina o plano arquitetônico para a plataforma de dados moderna, padronizando a ingestão, armazenamento, processamento e consumo de dados em toda a empresa.
  • Cloud & Modern Data Stack na Microsoft: Projete soluções escaláveis aproveitando o ecossistema de dados do Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure SQL Server, Azure Data Lake, CosmosDB e a adoção estratégica do Azure Fabric.
  • Business Intelligence (BI): Defina a arquitetura para relatórios e análises empresariais, soluções como Power BI e SSAS.
  • Integração e Engenharia de Dados: Estabelecer padrões técnicos para práticas e padrões de integração em Engenharia de Dados, utilizando tecnologias como Azure ADF, SSIS e integração segura de API para troca de dados em tempo real entre sistemas OT e de TI.

IA e Aprendizado de Máquina

  • Arquitetura de Plataforma de IA: Projete e governe a plataforma empresarial para construir, treinar e implantar modelos avançados usando Azure ML e explorar capacidades de próxima geração com Azure AI Foundry.
  • IA generativa (GenAI): Defina os padrões arquitetônicos para adoção da GenAI, focando especificamente na implementação segura e responsável de modelos de Geração Aumentada por Recuperação (RAG) para liberar valor de dados operacionais não estruturados.
  • Democratização do MLOps: Estabelecer a estrutura técnica e os padrões para a democratização do MLOps, utilizando Databricks e o Data Lake para garantir a implantação e o monitoramento rápidos, governados e automatizados dos modelos de aprendizado de máquina em ambientes de produção.

Governança e Conformidade de Dados

  • Estrutura de Governança: Definir e aplicar metodologias abrangentes de Governança de Dados para todas as novas arquiteturas de dados e aplicações.
  • Ferramentas de Governança: Arquiteto e supervisiona a implementação de ferramentas de governança chave, incluindo o Microsoft Purview para catalogação e linhagem unificada de dados.

Desempenho, Segurança e Conformidade

  • Garantir arquitetura de alto desempenho para cargas de trabalho em análise em larga escala e IA.
  • Implemente segurança, governança e conformidade robustas em todas as plataformas.

Colaboração & Liderança

  • Faça parceria com stakeholders de negócios, engenheiros de dados, desenvolvedores de BI e equipes de automação.
  • Ofereça liderança técnica e mentoria às equipes de projeto.
  • Atue como líder de pensamento para tecnologias emergentes em Analytics, Automação, IA e Governança.

Requisitos

  • 5+ anos em Tecnologia da Informação, com pelo menos 5 anos em funções práticas como Analista ou Arquiteto de Soluções.
  • Experiência trabalhando em empresas do setor Industrial ou de Mineração, por 2 anos ou mais.
  • Expertise em arquitetura de soluções utilizando serviços Azure Data and Analytics (por exemplo, Azure Fabric, Azure Data Lake, CosmosDB, Azure SQL, Power BI).
  • Experiência comprovada na definição de padrões para plataformas RPA, especificamente Power Automate/Power Apps.
  • Experiência aprofundada em arquitetura com plataformas de IA/ML como Azure ML, Databricks e implementação de padrões avançados como RAG e GenAI.
  • Sólida experiência com plataformas de Governança de Dados, incluindo Microsoft Purview.
  • Proficiência no design de padrões de integração usando tecnologias como Azure ADF, SSIS.

Requisitos desejáveis

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Position :Business Development Manager – Brazil

Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Company : XTransfer- (Cross-border Payments)


About Us

XTransfer is a leading global B2B cross-border financial service platform, dedicated to helping small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) reduce the cost and complexity of global trade.

With over 800,000 enterprise clients worldwide and a monthly transaction volume exceeding USD 12 billion, XTransfer connects SMEs with top-tier financial institutions through a secure and compliant infrastructure.

As we expand into Brazil, we are building a strong local team to support Brazilian importers and exporters with efficient, compliant, and cost-effective cross-border payment solutions.


Role Overview:

We are looking for high-performing Sales / Business Development professionals to join our Brazil team. This role focuses on acquiring and managing SME clients engaged in international trade, especially importers and exporters.

The ideal candidate has strong industry experience in logistics, customs clearance, trading companies, or fintech, with an existing client network and deep understanding of cross-border transactions.


Key Responsibilities:

Identify and acquire new SME clients engaged in import/export activities

Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their payment and FX needs

Promote XTransfer’s cross-border payment and financial solutions

Drive transaction volume growth and achieve individual sales targets

Conduct offline visits, networking, and industry outreach (e.G., trade hubs, exhibitions, logistics clusters)

Collaborate with internal teams (compliance, operations, marketing) to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery

Continuously collect market feedback and contribute to product localization and strategy

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following industries are highly preferred:

Freight forwarding / logistics companies

Customs brokers / import-export agents

Trading companies (especially China-Brazil trade)

Fintech / cross-border payment companies such as Remessa Online or EBANX

Foreign exchange or international banking services


Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or above

Minimum 2–5 years of B2B sales or business development experience

Strong understanding of Brazil’s import/export ecosystem and payment flows

Existing client network in trade, logistics, or SME sectors is a strong plus

Highly motivated, results-driven, and comfortable with target-based performance

Strong communication and negotiation skills

Fluent in Portuguese, English, Chinese is a plus


What We Offer:

Competitive salary + performance-based commission；

Fast-growing international fintech platform with strong global backing；

Opportunity to build and lead a new market from an early stage；

Exposure to cross-border trade, finance, and global business networks；

Clear career growth path in Brazil and globally；


Why Join Us

Brazil is one of the most dynamic and challenging markets for cross-border trade. At XTransfer, you will be at the forefront of transforming how SMEs handle international payments—making them faster, safer, and more cost-efficient.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Discover Peliplat

Peliplat is an online community made by film lovers, for film lovers! We’re evolving the way film enthusiasts and content creators interact;
transforming movie watching into a shared, interactive social experience .


With the launch of our interactive online screening platform , Peliplat is no longer just a place to talk about films;
it’s where audiences come together to discover, watch, and experience cinema in real time . From Virtual Screening Rooms and live co-watching events to fan driven discussions and creator-led sessions, we’re building a new kind of digital cinema for the next generation.


On Peliplat, film aficionados can share insights, express their reactions, host screenings, and collaborate on the creation of the next big hit. While our primary focus has been the Latin American market, we are now expanding globally, positioning ourselves as the home of movie buffs and a community shaping the future of cinema .

Join us and be part of this new era of interactive cinema!


What Will Your Next Role Look Like?

As our Marketing Specialist, you will lead the development and execution of growth strategies that position Peliplat as a must-try platform for film lovers.

You will create campaigns that spark curiosity, drive engagement, and fuel viral growth—leveraging influencers, community dynamics, and storytelling to scale our global presence.


Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute growth strategies to drive installs, engagement, and retention
  • Identify and scale viral loops, referral systems, and community-driven growth mechanisms
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Content teams to align growth initiatives

Campaign Development

  • Lead end-to-end campaign execution (e.G., “Watch With (Name),” themed screenings, launch campaigns)
  • Translate product features and content into compelling, user-facing narratives
  • Build campaigns that drive both immediate traction and long-term brand equity

Influencer & Partnership Strategy

  • Collaborate with influencers, creators, and partners to expand reach and credibility
  • Design and execute influencer programs and activation strategies
  • Identify high-potential creators and turn them into growth drivers for the platform

Performance & Optimization

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across key metrics (acquisition, engagement, retention)
  • Continuously test, iterate, and optimize campaigns based on data and insights


Who You Are

  • A builder mindset: you don’t just plan, you execute, test, and scale
  • Strong creative instinct paired with data-driven decision making
  • Deep interest in entertainment, culture, and digital communities
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly proactive, resourceful, and results-oriented


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
  • 3–7 years of experience in marketing, growth, or brand strategy
  • Proven track record of driving user acquisition and campaign performance
  • Experience in LATAM markets is strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical, communication, and execution skills


Our Culture

As Peliplat evolves into a global, product-driven company, our culture is not just something we believe in;
it’s how we execute.


We are building more than a platform;
we are shaping the home of movie buffs and redefining cinema as a shared, interactive experience . This requires a team that thinks beyond traditional models, moves with urgency, and creates value through both creativity and strategy.

Our culture is rooted in people who don’t just operate within systems, but who build, challenge, and scale them .

  • Ownership — Think Like a Builder
  • Strategic Hustle — Create Value Beyond Budget
  • Problem-Solving — Decode Complexity
  • Result Oriented — Drive Real Impact
  • Market Intelligence — Know the Game
  • Passion for Cinema & Community — Build What You Believe In

title: Security Biso/Pmo
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Security BISO/PMO




Resumo:

O Security BISO/PMO atua como um elo estratégico entre as unidades de tecnologia, negócio e a organização de cibersegurança. Essa função garante que as iniciativas de segurança estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, enquanto gerencia a entrega de projetos de segurança em toda a empresa. O profissional será responsável por conduzir a governança, priorizar demandas de segurança e supervisionar planos e execução de projetos para reduzir riscos e impulsionar o crescimento do negócio.



Responsabilidades:

Alinhamento com o Negócio:

  • Servir como ponto de contato principal para as unidades de negócio em relação às necessidades e iniciativas de cibersegurança.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em estratégias e soluções de segurança acionáveis junto às demais equipes de cibersegurança.
  • Defender a segurança nos processos de negócio, garantindo conformidade com padrões regulatórios e organizacionais.

Gestão de Programas e Projetos:

  • Liderar e gerenciar o portfólio de projetos de segurança, garantindo entrega dentro do escopo, prazo e orçamento.
  • Desenvolver e manter planos de projeto, registros de riscos e relatórios de status para as partes interessadas.
  • Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, incluindo TI, segurança e stakeholders de negócio, para atingir os objetivos dos projetos.

Governança e Relatórios:

  • Estabelecer e manter estruturas de governança para programas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e métricas relacionadas às iniciativas de segurança.
  • Garantir alinhamento com requisitos de gestão de riscos corporativos e conformidade.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificar, avaliar e priorizar riscos de segurança que impactam as operações do negócio e alinhar com o registro de riscos do GRC.
  • Colaborar com líderes de negócio para implementar estratégias de mitigação de riscos.

Engajamento com Stakeholders:

  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com executivos, líderes de negócio e equipes técnicas.
  • Fornecer atualizações regulares sobre postura de segurança, progresso dos projetos e ameaças emergentes.



Requisitos técnicos e experiência:

  • Graduação em Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração de Empresas ou área relacionada.
  • Mais de 7 anos em funções de cibersegurança, gestão de riscos ou gestão de projetos de segurança.
  • Forte conhecimento de frameworks de cibersegurança (NIST, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Alta proficiência e experiência prática com metodologias de gestão de projetos, planejamento e entrega, como PMBOK e Agile.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de influenciar e interagir com stakeholders seniores.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ou produtos.
  • Conhecimento avançado das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de elaboração de relatórios para suporte à entrega de KPIs.
  • Fluência em inglês.



Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Certificações em gestão de projetos ou gestão de produtos.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
    Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Brazil
description:
About Group-IB


Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses and citizens and support law enforcement operations.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.

Each of us can help make the world a safer place.

Join us!


The role:


As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.


This role is ideal for a motivated, self-starting sales professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets


Tasks to solve:


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Develops and implements sales strategies, manages sales pipelines, and monitors performance to achieve sales goals.
  • Team Leadership: Leads and motivates a sales team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and ensures customer satisfaction.
  • Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals.
  • Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM.
  • Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.


Qualifications


  • Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity.
  • Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Role-based in São Paulo.
  • Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team.
  • Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating.
  • Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans.
  • Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools


Why GROUP-IB?


  • Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy.
  • Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area.
  • Group-IB.A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? By choosing us, you will be choosing complex tasks and continuously improving your skills in a fast-growing international company.
  • Globally recognized technologies: Group-IB's members are located in 25 countries, and our products and services are sold in 60 countries. What’s more, Gartner, IDC, and Forrester have ranked our technologies among the best in their class. We work with over 450 international partners and about 500 clients.
  • A culture created by each of us: Group-IB’s employees speak many different languages and understand one another. We respect each other's beliefs, share common values, and strive toward the happiness of every employee.
  • Economic stability: Group-IB's sustainable growth helps rapidly develop careers that would take years to progress as far as most other companies.


What else should you know:


  • Flexible schedule: Group-IB does not have fixed working hours. You choose your schedule. We adhere to the principle advocated by Steve Jobs: “We have to work not 12 hours and head. ”Health: If anything goes wrong, don’t worry — we offer health insurance.
  • Certificates and training courses : Group-IB specialists hold over 1,000 professional certificates, including CEH, CISSP, OSCP, GIAC, MCFE, BSI, as well as some rare ones that would be a source of pride for experts in forensics, penetration testing, and reverse engineering worldwide. We have an incentive program that helps employees achieve certifications at the company's expense.
  • Challenges: A wide selection of GIB programs helps you improve soft skills, gain new competencies, and receive monetary rewards.
  • The initiative is rewarded: At Group-IB, you can bring your most daring ideas to life. The company encourages technical blogging, writing articles, building sports teams, and other creative activities.

title: Sales & Growth (Junior To Mid-Level)
description:
1. About Sofira


Sofira is building the future of legal services. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work, leveraging our team's 12 years of experience processing millions of legal documents.


Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points in legacy systems in Brazil, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.


2. The Opportunity


THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL SALES ROLE.


This is for someone who wants to build a commercial engine from scratch. You won't inherit a pipeline, a playbook, or a team. You will create all of that -- side by side with the founder (Priscila Holanda, CEO) and the co-founder (Pedro Leme, CTO).


You will be Sofira's growth engine. If we don't generate pipeline, we don't grow. And you will be the person who makes that happen every single day.


3. What You'll Do


3.1. Demand Generation (Outbound + Inbound)

  • Research and map target companies: identify who has high volumes of consumer complaints, who spends too much on outside counsel, who is unhappy with their current process
  • Find the right people inside those companies (Head of Legal, Litigation Manager, Director of Legal Operations) using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha, and whatever else works
  • Build and execute multichannel outreach cadences: cold email + LinkedIn + systematic follow-up
  • Schedule qualified meetings for the CEO

3.2. Content Marketing & Social Media

  • Create and publish content on Sofira's LinkedIn and support the founders' personal content
  • Produce posts, carousels, and content that positions Sofira as the authority in legal automation and AI applied to law
  • Monitor engagement, test formats, iterate fast
  • Help build the brand narrative

3.3. Market Intelligence

  • Map competitors, monitor legaltech market movements
  • Research trends in legal automation, AI in law, and legal ops
  • Feed the team with insights that inform product and positioning

3.4. Sales Operations

  • Keep Pipedrive flawless: every contact, every interaction, every status updated
  • Prepare pre-meeting briefings for the CEO ("Company X has Y cases/month, contact is Z, came from channel W")
  • Support preparation of sales materials: decks, one-pagers, case studies, proposals
  • Organize participation in events, webinars, and industry communities (AB2L, legaltech events)

3.5. Whatever Else is Needed

This is an early stage startup. Some weeks you'll help put together a data room for investors. Or research a potential partner. Or organize an event. If you're the type who says "that's not my job," this role is not for you.


4. Who You Are


  • Born hunter: You wake up thinking about how to reach the next person. Rejection doesn't shake you, it fuels you. You send the fifth follow-up without hesitation.
  • Obsessively organized: Your CRM is impeccable. You don't lose leads, don't forget follow-ups, don't leave contacts untagged.
  • Hacker mindset: You don't just do the work -- you figure out the best way to do it first. Before writing a cold email, you research the best outbound strategies. Before building a cadence, you study what actually converts. If the resource you need doesn't exist, you create it. If the conventional path doesn't work, you invent a new one. You get blood from a stone.
  • Curious about the market: You want to understand how legal departments work, what hurts them, and why our solution fixes it. You don't need to know law, but you need the hunger to understand the client.
  • AI-first: You use AI as leverage in your daily work. Lead research with AI, email copy with AI, market analysis with AI. If it can be done with AI, you do it with AI.


5. What You Need

  • You can be in the final year of your undergraduate degree or already graduated (up to 4 years of professional experience).
  • Track record of building things and leading projects -- junior enterprise (empresa junior), AIESEC, side projects, organizations, events. If you've never led or built anything, this role is not for you.
  • Reading comprehension in English (you need to be able to consume content, articles, and reference materials in English to keep learning -- speaking and writing fluency are not required).
  • Comfort with social media and content creation (you don't need to be an expert, but you should enjoy it and want to learn).


6. Nice to Have (Not Required, But Valued)

  • Experience with B2B prospecting, outbound sales, or growth marketing (even if it was an internship, side project, or as part of an empresa junior)
  • Experience in a startup or tech company


7. What You DON'T Need

  • A law degree
  • Years of enterprise sales experience (you'll learn here)
  • Experience with the legal market (we'll teach you the context you need in 1 week)
  • Previous experience with CRM or prospecting tools (you'll pick them up in days if you're smart)


8. Why You'll Love Building Sofira With Us

  • Direct impact: Every meeting you schedule can become a R$500K+/year client. You see the result of your work in weeks, not years.
  • Build from zero: You will build the commercial machine. The playbook that works will have your name on it.
  • Fast growth: This seat has a clear path to Head of Growth or Head of Sales as the company scales. And there's equity tied to performance.
  • Small team, massive impact: In an early-stage startup, you're not a cog -- you're the engine.
  • Real AI: This isn't a buzzword. You'll work with the hottest technology in the market applied to a real, multi-billion dollar problem.


9. The Deal


Let's be honest about what this is.


We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We are building something from nothing, and that takes everything we've got. The founders are all-in, and we expect the same from everyone who joins.


In return, this is what's on the table:

  • Equity. We want everyone who builds Sofira to get rich with us. Prove yourself, and you'll have a real stake in what we're building together.
  • Meteoric growth. You will learn more in 1 year here than in 5 years anywhere else. The person who builds our commercial engine will grow into a leadership role as the company scales.
  • Front-row seat to a market shift. Legal services is a $27B+ market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. You'll be part of changing that.


10. This Role is NOT For You If:

  • You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day
  • You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes
  • You're uncomfortable with rapid changes or aggressive targets
  • You want a fancy title more than you want to build something real


11. Details

  • Model: PJ (Independent Contractor)
  • Format: Hybrid (Sao Paulo)

title: Analista Governança De Tecnologia Da Informação Pleno

title: Analista De Gestão De Vulnerabilidades (Pleno)
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A Hakai é uma consultoria especializada em segurança da informação que oferece serviços de segurança e produtos customizados para atender às necessidades e metas de cada negócio. Nós identificamos falhas em sistemas e processos e ajudamos os clientes a mitigar os riscos associados, preservando suas informações e reputação.


Missão do Cargo

Fortalecer, consolidar e expandir o processo de gestão de vulnerabilidade em clientes estratégicos da Hakai de alta relevância no mercado por meio de uma atuação consultiva, orientada por dados, excelência operacional e resultados sustentáveis.

title: Senior Trade Marketing Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Trade Marketing Manager | Samsung Electronics


Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site



Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !



Job Summary

  • We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager in Retail Marketing to join our dynamic team.
  • The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and leading a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they effectively drive brand visibility, reinforce brand awareness, and achieve sales targets for consumer electronics categories, especially Visual Displays, in retail partner stores.
  • This role requires a deep understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and the ability to collaborate across functions to deliver impactful results.



Areas of Responsibilities in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing and executing strategies to enhance brand visibility and reinforce brand awareness in retail partner stores;
  • Collaborating with retail partners to optimize product placement, promotions, and in-store experiences that align with Samsung's brand identity;
  • Ensuring consistent brand representation and messaging across all retail channels.
  • Leading the planning and execution of retail marketing campaigns, including point-of-sale materials, stores activations, and events;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (sales, product management, creative) to ensure seamless execution of marketing plans;
  • Leading, mentoring, and managing a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they are well-trained and equipped to represent the brand effectively;
  • Monitoring campaign performance and adjust strategies as needed to achieve desired outcomes;
  • Monitoring and analyzing sales performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement;
  • Working closelywith promoters and store leaders to ensure the achievement of sales targets for consumer electronics categories;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations to drive sales growth and maximize ROI.
  • Tracking and analyzing key performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of retail marketing activities;
  • Preparing detailed reports on team performance, campaign results, and sales achievements for senior management;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Overseeing the allocation and management of retail marketing budgets to ensure cost-effective solutions;
  • Monitoring expenses and ensuring alignment with financial targets and budget execution.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Soid experience in retail marketing, with a proven track record in the electronics or consumer goods industry.
  • Strong understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and market trends.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and performance measurement tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions.
  • Fluence in English is mandatory.
  • Domain in MS office package to manage big data bases in Excel and presentation creations in Power point.
  • Strong story telling creation and presentation capabilities (in Portuguese and English).



Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: Diretor(A) De Marketing De Produtos
description:
A Omie está em busca de um(a) Head de Marketing de Produto (SaaS) para liderar a estratégia de posicionamento, crescimento e adoção do portfólio Omie e do seu ecossistema de soluções . Esta liderança terá papel central na construção da visão de mercado , na definição de narrativas e posicionamento de valor , e na conexão entre Produto, Marketing, Vendas, Growth, Sucesso do Cliente , além dos canais de distribuição (franquias e parceiros) e do canal contábil .


O escopo vai além do ritual clássico de Product Marketing: esta posição liderará também frentes complementares que ampliam o valor do ERP e sustentam a estratégia de “solução completa” para PMEs, incluindo:

  • Omie.Store: marketplace/ecossistema de parceiros e soluções complementares ao Omie ERP;
  • Arquitetura: apoio técnico-consultivo para vendas enterprise/complexas;
  • Treinamentos: educação e capacitação em escala para clientes;
  • Omie.HUB: conexão com e-commerce e marketplaces;
  • Omie.PDV: frente de loja para varejo, restaurante e serviços;
  • Figital: integração do comércio físico e digital, unindo HUB + PDV como frente estratégica.


Essa pessoa será responsável por orquestrar essas frentes dentro de uma cadência consistente de Marketing de Produto , preservando a essência: ser a maior referência em conhecimento de produto e mercado , elevando o nível de sales enablement , posicionamento e percepção de valor para times internos, franqueados, contadores e clientes.


Principais atividades


Estratégia e Go-to-Market

  • Definir e liderar a visão de Marketing de Produto da Omie, conectando estratégia de negócio, mercado e execução;
  • Consolidar o portfólio (ERP + HUB + PDV + ecossistema) em uma narrativa clara, consistente e orientada por segmentos e necessidades.
  • Atuar como guardião(a) do posicionamento competitivo, categorias e mensagens-chave, orientando como a Omie gera vantagem competitiva.
  • Liderar estratégias de Go-to-Market end-to-end para produtos, integrações e aquisições, garantindo impacto em adoção, retenção e expansão.
  • Estruturar playbooks e modelos replicáveis por tipo de oferta e canal (vendas diretas, franquias, parceiros e contadores).
  • Garantir um modelo de GTM contínuo, sustentando performance ao longo do ciclo de vida do cliente.
  • Atuar em parceria com Vendas e Growth na construção de abordagens consultivas, orientadas a valor e escaláveis.
  • Traduzir soluções complexas em propostas claras para públicos executivos, comerciais e técnicos.


Ecossistema, Omie.Store e parcerias

  • Definir e liderar a estratégia da Omie.Store como frente de crescimento e geração de receita.
  • Estruturar governança de parceiros, critérios de priorização por segmento e iniciativas de co-marketing e co-selling.
  • Evoluir o marketplace para uma operação orientada a performance, escala e impacto comercial.


Arquitetura e vendas complexas

  • Liderar a frente de Arquitetura como braço estratégico de pré-vendas para deals complexos e contas enterprise.
  • Definir critérios de atuação, métricas de impacto e ativos reutilizáveis que ampliem escala e eficiência comercial.


Treinamentos e adoção

  • Liderar a estratégia de treinamentos conectando educação à adoção, retenção e valor percebido.
  • Estruturar trilhas por perfil e maturidade, com governança de conteúdo e métricas de impacto.


Figital (Omie.HUB e Omie.PDV)

  • Sustentar o posicionamento estratégico das frentes Omie.HUB e Omie.PDV integradas ao ERP.
  • Liderar a tese Figital como diferencial competitivo, com GTM segmentado, replicável e orientado a crescimento.

title: Coordenador De Marketing Digital
description:
RESUMO DA DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:


O Coordenador de Marketing Digital será responsável por planejar, liderar, executar e supervisionar jornadas omnichannel estratégicas que impulsionem resultados expressivos para os produtos e marcas da empresa, alinhadas às estratégias corporativas e aos objetivos de negócios. Essa posição atuará como elo central entre as diversas áreas da organização para conceber e operacionalizar experiências integradas, centradas no cliente.


O profissional será responsável por desenhar jornadas com visão estratégica, selecionando os canais mais adequados, incorporando soluções inovadoras como Inteligência Artificial para acelerar entregas e ampliar o impacto. Além da dimensão estratégica, atuará como referência em UX (Experiência do Usuário), garantindo que cada ponto de contato com o cliente seja coerente, relevante e de alto valor.


A posição também lidera iniciativas digitais voltadas à expansão de mercado, aumento e ativação da base de clientes, campanhas digitais e aproximação com pacientes, além de realizar a gestão da equipe interna e de provedores.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Planejar e liderar jornadas omnichannel estratégicas junto as Áreas Chaves: Mapear, desenhar e implementar jornadas integradas para clientes, conectando os canais definidos pela companhia de forma coerente e estratégica, selecionando canais mais adequados para cada etapa. Orientar a construção das jornadas com base em dados, comportamento do usuário e objetivos de negócio.


  • Promover a integração estratégica entre áreas: Integrar Marketing, Medical, Força de Vendas, ExCom, TI, Regulatório e HQ para co-criar jornadas robustas e viáveis, garantindo a execução integral e alinhadas às iniciativas omnichannel.


  • Incorporar Inteligência Artificial e inovação na aceleração da transformação digital: Identificar, propor e implementar soluções de IA e automação que potencializem as jornadas do cliente, como personalização em escala, assistentes para a força de vendas, análise preditiva e recomendações inteligentes. Avaliar continuamente o cenário de inovação digital e trazer soluções que antecipem tendências e ampliem a vantagem competitiva da empresa.


  • Coordenar a experiência do usuário (UX) nas jornadas digitais: Aplicar metodologias e princípios de UX no desenho das jornadas e interfaces digitais, garantindo que os pontos de contato com clientes sejam intuitivos, acessíveis e centrados nas necessidades do usuário. Colaborar com HQ, TI e fornecedores para implementar melhorias contínuas nas plataformas e canais digitais com base em pesquisas de usabilidade, testes A/B e feedbacks dos usuários.


  • Liderar iniciativas digitais para expansão de mercado e crescimento da base de clientes: Desenvolver e executar estratégias digitais focadas em aquisição de novos clientes, ativação de base e retenção, com ações direcionadas a médicos, farmacêuticos, pacientes e outros stakeholders. Planejar e coordenar campanhas digitais integradas (mídia paga, SEO, e-mail marketing, whatsapp, marketing de conteúdo e redes sociais) alinhadas às prioridades dos produtos e marcas.


  • Promover a aproximação digital com pacientes: Desenvolver iniciativas e programas digitais que fortaleçam o vínculo entre a empresa, suas marcas e os pacientes, contribuindo para a adesão ao tratamento, educação em saúde e engajamento com os produtos. Garantir que as jornadas do paciente sejam construídas com ética, empatia e conformidade regulatória.


  • Analisar dados e monitorar a performance das jornadas e campanhas: Utilizar ferramentas de analytics, CRM e dashboards para monitorar o desempenho das jornadas e campanhas omnichannel, identificando gargalos, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Compartilhar insights periódicos com as áreas chave, orientando a tomada de decisão e o redirecionamento das estratégias.


  • Gerir o orçamento da área digital: Controlar o orçamento anual das iniciativas digitais, priorizando investimentos com base no retorno esperado e no alinhamento estratégico. Assegurar que fornecedores, agências e plataformas entreguem dentro dos parâmetros de custo, prazo e qualidade acordados.


  • Coordenar fornecedores, agências e parceiros digitais: Gerenciar o relacionamento com agências criativas, de mídia, tecnologia e parceiros estratégicos, garantindo qualidade nas entregas, cumprimento de prazos e alinhamento com as estratégias da empresa. Elaborar briefings, acompanhar projetos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e entregas.


  • Elaborar planos de treinamento digital para a força de vendas: Desenvolver materiais e dinâmicas de capacitação para a equipe comercial, promovendo a transformação digital e o uso eficaz das ferramentas e canais digitais disponíveis. Apoiar a área de Treinamento na criação de conteúdos que integrem as jornadas digitais à rotina da força de vendas.


  • Realizar a gestão do Jovem Aprendiz: Supervisionar, orientar e desenvolver o Jovem Aprendiz da área de Marketing Digital, garantindo sua integração às atividades do time, seu aprendizado prático e seu desenvolvimento profissional.


CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS:

Experiência:

  • +5 anos de experiência em Marketing Digital, com atuação comprovada em estratégias omnichannel, jornadas do cliente, iniciativas digitais e campanhas de marketing digital.
  • Experiência prévia com design de jornadas e/ou UX (User Experience), com conhecimento de metodologias centradas no usuário.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de marketing, CRM e plataformas de gestão de jornadas (ex: Salesforce, Veeva ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência com gestão de fornecedores, agências digitais e parceiros tecnológicos.
  • Desejável: experiência no setor farmacêutico, saúde ou life sciences.


Formação Acadêmica:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação Social, Administração de Empresas, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas.


  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Marketing Digital, UX/CX, Transformação Digital, Gestão de Produto Digital ou áreas afins será um diferencial relevante.


Idioma:


  • Espanhol: Intermediário
  • Inglês Intermediário


Conhecimentos Específicos:


  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de analytics (Power BI, Looker Studio ou equivalentes).

title: Mobile Qa Engineer
description:
Mobile QA Engineer

Location: LATAM


Looking for a talented and motivated Quality Test Engineer to contribute to the mission of helping the world’s farmers sustainably increase productivity using digital tools, mobile software, advanced analytics and high quality assurance standards. This role is a unique opportunity to join our dynamic Brazil laboratory, responsible for testing the web & mobile apps that will operate under extreme environments and help ensure a great experience for our customers.


You will work on creating Test Plans and Test Cases and in most cases performing the manual testing based on those Test Plans and Test Cases. You will ensure our applications are accurate, robust, scalable, performant and deployable, and will have the opportunity to work with large, "big data" sets such as scientific data, machine generated data from our farmer's equipment to geospatial data, precision agriculture, remote sensing, weather and soil data. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering and business partners to enable a seamless, high-quality experience for our customers.


What You Will Do:

  • Pair up with software engineers, product owners and test engineers to deliver manual test suites to validate our web and mobile (iOS, Android) applications

  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers to ensure the data and software tools they use are accurate and reliable
  • Write up test strategies, test plans, design documents, and whatever else may be needed
  • Actively engage in root cause analysis reviews
  • Assist in ongoing process improvement efforts to ensure test planning, execution, and reporting is effective and efficient
  • Create detailed incident reports for production issues, and work on triage and investigation
  • Be willing to take on other responsibilities and tackle a variety of engineering and testing problems - we are a small team and all share role
  • Be willing to be a representative of the QA team on a project and lead all test activities that are needed



Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience
  • Strong self-starter who will work closely and daily with an existing team of other self-starters
  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may be accepted
  • Nice to have: Agriculture degree with QA knowledge and experience
  • Understanding the SDLC and the tester role and responsibility within it
  • You understand deadlines and the need to deliver the most valuable things first
  • English fluency

  • at least B2 level of English, Cambridge or similar certification is a Plus
  • Understanding of common user interface design patterns and software quality assurance methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile teams, experience in SAFe is a Plus


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with blackbox testing
  • Strong experience with web
  • Medium experience with mobile and API testing
  • ISTQB certification is a Plus
  • basic programmer knowledge is a Plus


We also hinge our cultural DNA on these five values:

  • Inspire one another
  • Innovate in all we do
  • Leave a mark on the world
  • Find the possible in the impossible

title: Head Of Merchant Growth (Cs)
description:
Role Summary

As the Merchant Operations Manager - Merchant Growth , you will drive the growth and success of merchant partners on Keeta's platform through data-driven strategies and multi-dimensional optimization. You will leverage traffic allocation, marketing campaigns, menu optimization, and targeted initiatives to help merchants achieve sustainable growth. In this strategic role, you will develop and execute merchant segmentation strategies, collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement growth initiatives, and continuously optimize the merchant experience to maximize platform value.


Key Responsibilities

1. Merchant Growth Strategy & Segmentation

  • Develop and implement comprehensive growth strategies for merchant partners, utilizing traffic optimization, marketing campaigns, menu enhancement, and operational improvements.
  • Create merchant segmentation frameworks based on performance, category, and potential to deliver targeted growth strategies.

2. Data-Driven Growth Optimization

  • Analyze traffic patterns and customer behavior to design and execute optimal traffic allocation strategies that maximize merchant visibility and acquisition.
  • Leverage performance data to develop and optimize marketing campaigns across in-app and external channels, driving merchant growth and engagement.
  • Use conversion analytics to identify optimization opportunities and implement solutions that improve merchant performance across the customer journey.

3. Competitive Intelligence & Market Insights

  • Monitor competitor strategies, pricing models, and market trends to inform merchant growth recommendations.
  • Provide actionable insights on market dynamics and competitive positioning to help merchants optimize their offerings.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Operations teams to implement growth strategies and optimize platform features.
  • Collaborate with merchant management teams to align growth initiatives with merchant needs and capabilities.
  • Drive end-to-end execution of growth projects, from strategy development to implementation and measurement.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or related field.
  • Solid experience in e-commerce, platform operations, or merchant growth, preferably in food delivery or similar sectors.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, BI tools) and performance tracking.
  • Experience with digital marketing optimization and campaign management.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across functions.
  • Fluent English for cross-border collaboration.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in food delivery or on-demand platforms where merchant growth is critical for platform success.
  • Background in merchant operations, growth strategy with a track record of driving measurable results.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with experience in A/B testing, experimentation, and data-driven decision making.
  • Project management skills with the ability to drive cross-functional initiatives from strategy to execution.


Why Join Keeta?

  • Direct Merchant Impact: Your strategies will directly help thousands of merchants grow and succeed on our platform.
  • Growth at Scale: Work on complex growth challenges across multiple markets and merchant segments in a high-impact role.

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.G., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and workflows effectively, including AI-enabled automation, agent-based ways of working, etc.
  • Passion for Gaming: Active gamer with a genuine interest in gaming culture and content.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
  • Tools: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, and structured data handling.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

description:
Analista de CS

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?

  • Definição estratégica: conduzir análises e propor recomendações que suportem decisões de negócio através de um programa de VoC (Voice od Customer);
  • Storytelling executivo: criar materiais que traduzam dados e insights em narrativas estratégicas, com plano de ações das áreas;
  • Capacidade de mapeamento de processos e fluxos de atendimento;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das áreas, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento e execução, com reuniões recorrentes e reports para COMEX;
  • Acompanhar indicadores chave, identificar riscos e oportunidades e propor ajustes estratégicos;
  • Lidar com múltiplos assuntos com resiliência e comprometimento;


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir análises a partir de dados e feedbacks de clientes, apoiando a evolução do programa de VoC (Voice of Customer).
  • Estruturar e evoluir indicadores de experiência, como NPS e CSAT, incluindo análises e ações de melhoria (close the loop).
  • Criar materiais executivos, traduzindo dados e insights em storytelling claro, com direcionamento de ações para as áreas.
  • Mapear e analisar jornadas, processos e fluxos de atendimento, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e eficiência.

  • Utilizar ferramentas como CRM, Excel, PowerPoint, Miro e Tableau para análise, organização e comunicação das iniciativas.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente, mantendo organização, priorização e qualidade nas entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias de experiência do cliente, como NPS e CSAT, incluindo análise e práticas de close the loop
  • Experiência em Customer Success ou Relacionamento com Cliente, preferencialmente no setor de seguros
  • Vivência com projetos de Voice of Customer (VoC)

  • Capacidade de mapear processos, jornadas e fluxos de atendimento

Você pode se destacar se:

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Company Description
About TOMRA Food:
TOMRA Food is a multi-national organization and a leading provider of sensor based sorting and processing technology for the fresh and processed food industries. Developing state-of-the-art technologies, optimizing customers' production flow, and helping to deliver consistent high quality output have been our strengths for more than 30 years in the food industry. We thrive off passion that always focuses and commits to meeting success. We demand a responsible and safe mindset that takes care of our customers, products and fellow employees.
Job Description
The Field Service Engineer (FSE) plays a key role in delivering high-quality service that enhances machine performance and ensures an exceptional customer experience. Our FSEs are proactive, solutions-focused professionals who take initiative and are accountable for the delivery, installation, and ongoing maintenance of our equipment.
They bring a well-rounded skill set in mechanical, electrical, and computer systems, including equipment operation, assembly, and installation. Their responsibilities span the full service lifecycle—from initial setup through preventive maintenance—ensuring our customers consistently achieve optimal results.
Collaboration is essential in this role. FSEs work closely with both customers and internal teams, promoting safety and reliability while upholding our global standards of excellence.
Operations
  • Ensure that machines are working according to customer expectations.
  • React to machine problems in the field within an appropriate time frame and ensure prompt resolution. When an easy solution is not possible, make sure the customer is well informed about the plan and potential costs.
  • Solves mechanical or operational efficiency problems.
  • Troubleshoot machine and/or performance issues until resolved.
  • Perform preventative maintenance to include pre- and post-season machine maintenance and work to improve the continuous performance of the machines.
  • Complete disassembly and installation of mechanical components such as shafts, bearings, belts, motors.
  • Maintain close relationship with sales leadership by providing updates to customers and advising on potential sales opportunities or customer concerns for follow-up action(s).
  • Actively contributes to continuous improvement activities.
  • Assist with the training and development of new Field Service Engineers as requested.
Customer service
  • Address or escalate customer complaints;
    ensure these are investigated or resolved, where possible, in a timely, clear and professional manner.
  • Work proactively with customers and internal stakeholders to successfully complete projects (eg, testing, retrofits, retrofits, or R&D site upgrades).
  • Conduct customer training, as required.
Qualifications
  • Preferred background: Technical or Engineering degree in Automation and Robotics, Mechatronics, Industrial Electricity, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
  • 0-2 years of experience.
  • Must have class B driver's license.

  • SEC A or B electrical installer license, not exclusive but desirable.
  • English at least at an intermediate level to have a communicative conversation.
  • Ability to interpret manuals, electrical, electronic and other diagrams.
  • Orientation towards the external client, good problem-solving capacity, analytical skills and ability to work under pressure, good communication skills.
  • Availability to relocate and travel frequently.
Additional Information
  • Ability to bend, kneel, and stand frequently, and work in confined spaces.
  • Capacity to work under pressure.
  • Ability to lift up to 20 kilos, on a regular basis.
  • Ability to distinguish between the full range of colors in the color spectrum
  • Ability to work in food processing plants, farms, cold storage facilities, and outdoors in high or low temperatures.
  • Must be able to drive without restrictions and possess a valid driver's license.
  • Not have significant food allergies that impede the ability to work around or near food, nuts, fruits, and vegetables.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively and must be able to obtain a valid passport to travel
Benefits
You will have long-term career opportunities, with a globally renowned company and the following:
  • Parental Leave (up to 8 weeks according to internal policy)
  • Referral and Jubilee bonus
  • Professional Training and Development
  • Global Career Opportunities with strong record for internal promotions

title: Sdr | Prospecção Ativa + Atendimento Inbound
description:
Este SDR atua nas duas frentes: atende leads que chegam via campanhas digitais (inbound) e também prospecta ativamente novos clientes no mercado (outbound). É o profissional que abre portas — e mantém o funil cheio todos os dias

Atividades:


Atendimento de Leads Digitais

  • Atender com agilidade leads que chegam via Google Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn e site
  • Fazer o primeiro contato por ligação em até 1 hora após a conversão
  • Qualificar o lead: identificar perfil, dor, urgência e fit com as soluções da ATS
  • Enviar e-mail e WhatsApp de apresentação e follow-up personalizado
  • Registrar todas as interações no CRM e agendar reuniões para o time de Closers

Prospecção Ativa

  • Montar listas de prospecção com empresas dentro do perfil ideal de cliente (ICP)
  • Abordar decisores via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, cold call e cold e-mail
  • Executar cadências multicanal: e-mail + ligação + WhatsApp + LinkedIn
  • Criar o interesse e gerar reuniões qualificadas mesmo com leads que nunca ouviram falar da ATS
  • Personalizar abordagens por segmento, porte e dor específica de cada empresa

Gestão de Processo

  • Manter o CRM 100% atualizado — histórico, status e próximos passos de cada lead
  • Cumprir metas diárias e semanais de contatos, cadências e agendamentos
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e treinamentos com o time comercial
  • Contribuir com feedbacks do mercado para ajustar discurso e ICP


Perfil Comportamental — Quem tem sucesso nessa cadeira

Usamos o modelo DISC para entender quem performa melhor. Para essa vaga, buscamos predominância I + D: comunicativo, persuasivo, direto e orientado a resultado.


I — Influência (perfil base)

Cria rapport rápido, é natural no contato, convence sem pressionar. Essencial para abrir portas.

✅ Resiliência: Recebe 'não' e volta mais forte. Não desanima com cadência e rejeição.

✅ Coachability: Absorve feedback e ajusta o discurso rapidamente. Aprende sem ego.

✅ Senso de dono: Trata o pipeline como seu negócio. Não espera mandar — age.


D — Dominância (traço necessário)

Direto, sem enrolação. Age com urgência e não deixa o lead esfriar.

✅ Disciplina: Executa volume todos os dias. Cadência sem disciplina não existe.

✅ Curiosidade investigativa: Apura dores do prospect. Não segue script cegamente — pensa junto.

✅ Comunicação adaptável: Muda o tom conforme o canal: formal no e-mail, direto na ligação.


Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo (superior em andamento é diferencial)
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita — ligação, e-mail e WhatsApp
  • Capacidade de lidar com objeções e manter cadência de contatos
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (e-mail, LinkedIn, WhatsApp Business)


Diferenciais (não obrigatório)

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, BDR, televendas ou prospecção B2B
  • Uso de CRM (Kommo, RD Station, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator ou ferramentas de prospecção
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em automação, IA ou tecnologia B2B
  • Familiaridade com cadências multicanal e técnicas de cold call / cold e-mail


O que oferecemos

  • Salário fixo + comissão por agendamento qualificado e conversão
  • Treinamento completo: produto, ICP, discurso, objeções e ferramentas
  • Leads inbound chegando todo dia + suporte para prospecção ativa
  • Produto relevante: automação e IA são as maiores demandas do mercado agora
  • Time jovem, dinâmico e com cultura de resultado
  • Crescimento real: SDR com performance tem trilha direta para Closer ou Executivo Comercial
  • Regime — CLT
